exposure: Use of Fetal Pillow vs. hand-push method for full-dilatation cesarean deliveries
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 160 women who underwent full-dilatation cesarean deliveries at term
finding: The use of the Fetal Pillow during full-dilatation cesarean deliveries was associated with lower intra-operative blood loss, shorter postpartum hospital admission, and higher cord arterial pH compared to the hand-push method.
mod_finding: The Fetal Pillow appears to be a safe and effective aid for the delivery of the fetal head during cesarean deliveries at full dilatation.
